Preconditions: User is a REDCap super user
Test Steps: Open the Data Bridge project page
Expected Result: Configuration page opens

Preconditions: User has project Design rights
Test Steps: Open the Data Bridge project page
Expected Result: Configuration page opens

Preconditions: User has no Design rights; user's role is selected in configuration_roles
Test Steps: Open the Data Bridge project page
Expected Result: Configuration page opens

Preconditions: User has no Design rights; user's role is not selected in configuration_roles
Test Steps: Open the Data Bridge project page
Expected Result: Access is denied

Preconditions: Valid target API URL and token with required permissions
Test Steps: Enter connection details and select Test connection
Expected Result: Target project metadata summary is displayed without saving the credentials

Preconditions: Valid target API URL and token with required permissions
Expected Result: Connection is saved and target forms and fields become available for mapping

Preconditions: Invalid API URL or token
Expected Result: A clear API error is shown and no target metadata is loaded

Preconditions: A target token is already saved
Test Steps: Open the page and inspect the browser response and page source
Expected Result: The saved token is not returned to the browser

Preconditions: A target connection is saved
Test Steps: Inspect the api_key External Module project setting with authorized database access
Expected Result: The stored value has the rdb-token:v1 prefix and does not contain the plaintext token

Preconditions: A token was saved by an earlier module version
Test Steps: Open the Data Bridge page or run a transfer
Expected Result: The connection still works and the setting is replaced with encrypted storage

Preconditions: The stored encrypted token is damaged
Test Steps: Open the page or run a transfer
Expected Result: Decryption fails closed and the damaged value is never sent to the target API

Preconditions: A valid target connection is saved
Expected Result: Source and target forms fields types validation and coded choices are available

Preconditions: Source and target metadata are loaded
Test Steps: Add a rule and select source instrument target form identity fields and one mapping
Expected Result: The rule can be saved and remains after reloading the page

Preconditions: Multiple rules exist
Test Steps: Expand and collapse each rule card
Expected Result: Only the selected card needs to remain open and its controls retain their values

Preconditions: Two rules exist with unsaved edits in different cards
Expected Result: Only the selected rule is persisted and the other rule remains unchanged in storage

Preconditions: A saved rule exists
Expected Result: The rule is removed from stored configuration and the remaining cards stay available

Preconditions: Source and target metadata are loaded
Test Steps: Search a mapping selector by field name and then by label
Expected Result: Matching fields from all project instruments are shown with both field name and label

Preconditions: Source or target project contains descriptive fields
Expected Result: Descriptive fields are not offered and cannot be saved through a modified request

Preconditions: Choose source and target fields with different field types
Expected Result: The rule is rejected with a field type error

Preconditions: Choose text fields with different REDCap validation types
Expected Result: The rule is rejected with a validation mismatch error

Preconditions: Choose compatible radio or dropdown fields
Expected Result: Choice code label and order compatibility is shown

Preconditions: Source and target coded fields use different raw codes
Test Steps: Map every source choice to a target choice and save
Expected Result: The rule saves and each raw source value is translated during transfer

Preconditions: A coded source choice has no target choice selected
Expected Result: The rule is rejected and identifies the unmapped choice

Preconditions: Compatible source and target checkbox fields exist
Test Steps: Map every source option and submit a survey
Expected Result: Target checkbox fields are sent as field___code values with selected values 1 and unselected values 0

Preconditions: A saved enabled rule has a REDCap condition that evaluates true
Expected Result: Transfer proceeds immediately after that survey completes

Preconditions: A saved enabled rule has a REDCap condition that evaluates false
Expected Result: Transfer is skipped

Preconditions: A rule has no REDCap condition
Expected Result: The rule is rejected because a condition is required

Preconditions: No target record contains the source record ID; target auto-numbering is enabled
Expected Result: Target REDCap creates the next record ID and stores the source record ID in the secondary identity field

Preconditions: Exactly one target record contains the same source record ID
Expected Result: The existing target record is updated rather than creating a duplicate

Preconditions: More than one target record contains the same source record ID
Expected Result: Transfer fails safely and no target record is imported

Preconditions: Target record ID and secondary source-ID field are set to the same field
Expected Result: The rule is rejected

Preconditions: The selected target source-ID field is a text field with integer validation
Test Steps: Save a rule whose source project uses numeric record IDs
Expected Result: The rule is accepted and the numeric source record ID can be stored

Preconditions: A source radio or dropdown field is mapped
Expected Result: The configured raw code is sent rather than the displayed label

Preconditions: A target form is selected in the saved rule
Expected Result: Target payload does not include or change the target form completion field

Preconditions: A longitudinal target project and event are selected
Expected Result: Target payload contains the selected unique event name

Preconditions: A longitudinal target project is connected but no event is selected
Expected Result: The rule is rejected

Preconditions: A required radio or dropdown contains a Success choice and import succeeds
Expected Result: Source status is saved using the raw code for Success

Preconditions: A required radio or dropdown contains a Failed choice and lookup or import fails
Expected Result: Source status is saved using the raw code for Failed

Preconditions: A configured source status field is already nonblank
Test Steps: Complete the configured source survey again
Expected Result: No additional lookup or import is attempted

Preconditions: A field other than radio or dropdown is submitted as status
Expected Result: The rule is rejected

Preconditions: A rule has no source status field
Expected Result: The rule is rejected and the status selector is focused

Preconditions: A dropdown is missing Success or Failed or contains duplicate matching labels
Expected Result: The rule is rejected and the missing or duplicate choice is clearly shown

Preconditions: A dropdown choices are labelled SUCCESS and failed
Expected Result: The choices are detected and their raw codes are written for each outcome

Preconditions: A source instrument has multiple repeat instances
Expected Result: Only the exact source instrument and repeat instance N are transferred

Preconditions: The triggering repeat row cannot be found
Expected Result: Transfer is skipped and another instance is never substituted

Preconditions: Two enabled rules use the same source instrument
Expected Result: Each rule is independently evaluated and run in saved order

Preconditions: A saved rule is disabled
Expected Result: The disabled rule is not executed

Preconditions: Two users open the same configuration revision
Test Steps: User A saves then user B saves stale changes
Expected Result: User B receives a revision conflict and does not overwrite user A

Preconditions: A transfer fails or configuration changes
Expected Result: API tokens and full record payloads are not stored

Preconditions: A transfer fails
Test Steps: Review module behaviour and email delivery
Expected Result: The module sends no email; REDCap Alerts remain available separately
